$description: ScatterChart (platform/charts/ScatterChart.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. Points and trend lines take their series' data-viz color (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

scatter-default-color.$description: Scatter chart: a point's color without data-plx-dataviz (the first categorical color).

scatter-margin-block-start.$description: Scatter chart: the room above the plot.

scatter-margin-inline-end.$description: Scatter chart: the room after the plot, so the last tick label of the x axis is not cut.

scatter-margin-block-end.$description: Scatter chart: the room under the plot for the x tick labels and the x axis title.

scatter-margin-inline-start.$description: Scatter chart: the room before the plot for the y tick labels and the y axis title.

scatter-point-opacity.$description: Scatter chart: a point's fill opacity, so points that overlap stay visible.

scatter-bubble-opacity.$description: Bubble chart: a bubble's fill opacity, lower than a point's, as bubbles overlap more.

scatter-point-outline-width.$description: Scatter chart: the outline of a point in its own color, so its edge shows where it overlaps.

scatter-trend-width.$description: Scatter chart: the trend line's stroke.

scatter-trend-dash.$description: Scatter chart: the trend line's dash, which tells it from the points.

scatter-trend-gap.$description: Scatter chart: the gap between the trend line's dashes.
